test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.**

options.text: Ashok was in the bus stop.
Ashok was to the bus stop.
Ashok was on the bus stop.
Ashok was at the bus stop.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Ashok was at the bus stop**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***At ***is a preposition and adverb of time.
 
• It
